source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Αρέτιος και Δακιανός οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The two are carried on one page with a head line each and no year against either, and the whole narrative is one sentence: that the holy martyrs Aretios and Dacianus bore witness at Rome. There is no year, no reign, no manner of death and no order between them, so there is no `dates` object; Rome is all the place there is and `locations` is left out. The corpus keeps neither name. No hymn is printed and no verse. His companion has his own folder in the same batch and a `related` row here; the slug carries the city because the day's line gives nothing else to tell either of them apart by.
